title: Four Japanese - Revolvers

page_data.en:
No
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
G. 11
No. 206
2/5/16.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
May 2nd 1916.
Sir,
At 9 p.m. 30th ultimo when four Japanese carrying parcels entered Chinese territory from the French Bund they were stopped by the Police on duty who went forward to see what they had. Seeing the intention of the Constables, the Japanese bolted. Three of them succeeded in escaping but one was arrested. He had three revolvers in his possession. He was taken to the Arsenal where he is now detained.
The pig skin box makers resumed work on 1st inst. The masters have agreed to increase their wages by 150 cash per standard box, and proportionately for other boxes.
At 2 p.m. 1st inst the Arsenal Authorities raided a chow shop near the main gate of the Arsenal and found two bombs as well as a quantity of gun powder on the premises. The master of the shop and his assistants had absconded a few hours previously.
The rebels are working hard in Pootung with a view to getting up an insurrection in the Nanwei district.
Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
Copy sent to S.V.C.
Entered on card May 2.
page_data.zh:
编号
（印章：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股。）
G. 11
第 206 号
1916年5月2日。
致上海工部局。
1916年5月2日。
先生：
上月30日晚9时，四名携带包裹的日本人从法租界外滩进入华界，被执勤巡捕拦下，巡捕上前查看其携带物品。日本人见巡捕意图，随即逃窜。其中三人成功逃脱，一人被捕。该人身上藏有三把左轮手枪。他已被带往兵工厂，目前羁押于此。
猪皮箱制作工人于本月1日复工。雇主已同意每只标准箱增加工资150文铜钱，其他规格箱子按比例增加。
本月1日下午2时，兵工厂当局突袭了兵工厂大门附近的一家熟食店，在现场发现两枚炸弹及大量火药。店主及其伙计数小时前已潜逃。
反叛分子在浦东积极活动，企图在南市区发动暴乱。
您顺从的仆人，
总探长。
警务处总监。
副本已送交义勇枪会（S.V.C.）。
5月2日录入卡片。
